notes: Ten unaltered 1920x1080 native app-window screenshots, captured in Meshcraft 0.48.5.
Nine project-scale models are retained with MCP construction recipes and modeling journals under scenes/projects and captures/projects.
Scenes include a controller assembly, configurable kitchen and casework, a courtyard residence, loft, rooftop garden, pocket park, pump skid and furnished studio.
Screenshots contain real GPUI controls and live model/preview geometry; there are no reconstructed interfaces or marketing overlays.
Captures use Linux GPUI with isolated Xvfb/Mesa, not Windows runtime validation or a performance benchmark.
The existing promotional artwork remains a separate set of nine artwork files with its own source geometry.
Projects, recipes, captures and import bundles live outside Cargo target.
